title: Uhlmann Pac-Systeme | LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH & Co. KG is a leading global systems supplier for the packaging of pharmaceutical products in blisters, bottles, and cartons. The company offers flexible integral solutions that meet the challenges of international pharmaceutical companies, generics manufacturers, and contract packers. These include ever higher demands on reliability and cost efficiency, as well as product traceability, which is mandatory in many countries. On the basis of its innovative portfolio, including blister machines, bottle lines, cartoners, and end-of-line packaging machines, Uhlmann has been setting standards in terms of quality, efficiency, and availability for decades. Over time, the company has become a total solution provider: 360° PHARMA PACKAGING stands for consultation, project management, implementation, comprehensive services and digital solutions from a single source. The company, headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, operates worldwide and guarantees close support through twenty sales and services bases. Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH & Co. KG was established in 1948 and is part of the Uhlmann Group, which is in its third generation of family management. The Group has a workforce of around 2,500 and generated sales amounting to EUR 504 million in the business year 2024/25. Further members of the Uhlmann Group are the companies Koch Pac-Systeme and Goldfuß Engineering in Germany, Cremer Speciaalmachines in the Netherlands, Axito in Poland, and Wonder Packing Machinery in China. As of October 2019, appropriate elements of central functions are pooled in the newly formed Uhlmann Group Holding GmbH & Co. KG. title: Our mission statement - Uhlmann Pac-Systeme
content: View from a meadow of the Uhlmann company building. Pharmaceutical packaging has been our core business for over 75 years and our global, pioneering role is primarily due to the trust our customers place in the groundbreaking performance of our teams. Strong, open and reliable - this is how we want our customers, partners and employees to experience us – because these are the qualities upon which we are basing the packaging ecosystem of tomorrow. We ensure global availability of sensitive products to improve quality of life for generations. We want to improve the quality of life – today and for generations to come. The packaging of pharmaceutical products is and remains our core business. From the planning of the packaging to the operation of the plant we advise our customers and deliver end-to-end solutions along the complete lifecycle. Our daily actions and our goals are in line with the Uhlmann values. Frontal view of an end-of-line packaging machine.

title: 75 years of first-class packaging systems - Uhlmann Pac-Systeme
content: Black and white photograph of a building from 1948. Next to it for comparison is the large Uhlmann building complex in 2023. The young Marilyn Monroe was about to make her breakthrough as an actress, Elvis Presley was just 13 years old – and Josef Uhlmann set up a machine factory in Laupheim. Come with us on a journey into the past and experience Uhlmann in the past and today! Frontal view of the old Uhlmann company building in black and white, with a tree in the middle. View of the Uhlmann company building with green trees against a blue sky. After starting out in rented premises, the company moved to a new building in Uhlandstrasse in Laupheim in 1956, which came to be known as Plant 1. Today, Uhlmann’s headquarters are still located in Laupheim, about one kilometer as the crow flies from what was then “Plant 1” in Uhlmannstrasse.
